title: Tesle ERP  Manufacturing Giant
shortDescription: Full ERP implementation for a multinational manufacturing company, replacing 7 legacy systems with one unified platform.
fullDescription: We deployed Tesle ERP across a multinational manufacturing operation with 12 factories, 8 warehouses, and 3,000+ employees. The implementation replaced 7 legacy systems  including disparate accounting, inventory, and HR platforms  with a single unified operating system. The result: 40% reduction in operational costs, real-time visibility across the entire supply chain, and AI-driven demand forecasting that reduced stockouts by 60%.

testimonial.quote: Tesle ERP eliminated the chaos of running 7 different systems. We now have one source of truth for finance, inventory, HR, and operations  and our AI-powered demand forecasts have transformed our supply chain.
testimonial.author: Kofi Mensah

results: 60% fewer stockouts with AI demand forecasting
